module origen_122333 (
    input [15:0] ADDER, BUS, PC1,
    input [1:0] Select,
    output reg [15:0] Output
);
    always @(*) begin
        case (Select)
            2'b00: Output = PC1;
            2'b01: Output = BUS;
            2'b10: Output = ADDER;
            2'b11: Output = 16'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule
